title: Wanchoo Committee: more on mandate, courts, Tungabhadra

boxes.title: Mandates & capital: added detail
items: Kumaraswamy Raja committee also covered =="administrative arrangements"== for the new state
Wanchoo's reason for Madras: ==lack of capital infrastructure==
Nehru: a **temporary** capital in Andhra; some offices could stay in Madras a while
**25 March** = Nehru's announcement date, not the report

boxes.title: Courts & Tungabhadra
items: Madras HC jurisdiction until the ==Andhra HC site was decided==
**Bellary district court** to serve **Adoni, Alur, Rayadurg** for the time being (Nehru, 25 Mar 1953)
**Sreebagh Pact** rivers: ==**Tungabhadra, Krishna, Penna**==; priority "or as needed"

lines: Assets by **location**, debts by **population** → AP heavy debt share
